new.name: getComponentDetails
new.description: Retrieves comprehensive implementation details for a single Magic UI component by name, including full source code, installation instructions, and all associated examples. Use this when you already know one component name (e.g., from searchComponents or getComponentIndex results) and need its complete implementation. If you already know several component names, use getComponentsByNames instead.

new.name: getComponentIndex
new.description: Provides a full categorized index of Magic UI components with example coverage counts to help clients discover components by category. Use searchComponents for keyword/category-filtered queries. Once you identify components, call getComponentDetails for a single component, getComponentsByNames for a hand-picked list of known components, or use category-specific tools to fetch multiple components at once.

new.name: getComponentsByNames
new.description: Retrieves comprehensive implementation details for multiple known Magic UI components in a single request, including full source code, installation instructions, and associated examples for each found component. Use this after getComponentIndex or searchComponents when you already know a specific set of component names and want a targeted batch fetch without pulling an entire category.

new.name: searchComponents
new.description: Searches Magic UI components by keyword (matched against name and description) with an optional category filter. Returns matching components with their category assignments and example counts. After finding relevant components, use getComponentDetails to fetch a single component's full implementation, getComponentsByNames to fetch several selected matches at once, or call the appropriate category tool to retrieve multiple components at once.
